integrity: The all-parameter theorem is proved by the block-token normal form and weak compositions. Exhaustive and structural finite checks reproduce the stated formulas but do not replace the proof. Earlier alternating-pattern and two-letter cases are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: For binary alternating hosts and prescribed two-run patterns with both runs nonempty and total pattern length at least three; no assertion about general hosts, patterns, or independent mathematical validation.
title: Split-invariant complement-fiber spectrum for two-run deletions from alternating words
